name: Navas de Oro (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navas de Oro (a tower on red and a pine on blue) between four red crosses of Saint James, one in each corner.
history: The arms and flag of Navas de Oro were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 19 February 1997; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, yellow, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre and cantoned with four crosses.

features.role: Navas de Oro arms — tower on red and pine on blue
crosses of Saint James in the four corners
